def answer(L, R):
    """Write a python function to find two distinct numbers such that their lcm lies within the given range.

    Return two distinct numbers in ``[L, R]`` whose lcm is also in
    ``[L, R]``.  ``(L, 2 * L)`` works whenever ``2 * L <= R``, since
    ``lcm(L, 2 * L) == 2 * L``.  No such pair can exist when
    ``2 * L > R`` (for distinct ``a < b`` in ``[L, R]``, ``lcm(a, b)``
    is either ``b`` only if ``a`` divides ``b``, which would require
    ``b >= 2 * a > R``, or at least ``2 * b > R``), so ``(-1, -1)``
    is returned in that case.
    """
    if L < 1 or R < 2 * L:
        return (-1, -1)
    return (L, 2 * L)
